skycraft.calendar.quest.title: Festival Errand: %s
skycraft.calendar.quest.objective: Take part in the %s celebrations and speak with the townsfolk
skycraft.calendar.festival.new_life_fest: Braziers blaze in Windhelm's Stone Quarter as Nords toast the return of the sun with free spiced mead!
skycraft.calendar.festival.south_winds_p: Lanterns hang beneath Whiterun's Gildergreen as priests of Kynareth pray for mild winds and a fruitful thaw.
skycraft.calendar.festival.hearts_day.an: Pink banners and sweetroll stalls line Riften's canals as the Temple of Mara blesses betrothed couples.
skycraft.calendar.festival.first_plantin: Farmers in Rorikstead and the Whiterun plains bless the ploughs and share fresh loaves for the spring sowing.
skycraft.calendar.festival.dawnstar_ice_: Dawnstar's harbour rings with bells as the Sea of Ghosts pack ice cracks and the first spring ships set sail.
skycraft.calendar.festival.jesters_day.a: Bards College troubadours fill Solitude's cobbled avenue with riddles, street theatre, and festive banners!
skycraft.calendar.festival.second_planti: Falkreath drapes its pine archways in spring garlands as Arkay's priests bless the late-spring planting.
skycraft.calendar.festival.morthal_midye: Soul lanterns glow along Morthal's boardwalks as townsfolk renew the midsummer wards against the marsh fog.
skycraft.calendar.festival.burning_of_ki: The Bards College lights King Olaf's effigy bonfire in Solitude and pours spiced wine for all travellers!
skycraft.calendar.festival.merchants_fes: Whiterun's Plains District bustles with open market stalls and caravan traders for the Merchants' Festival.
skycraft.calendar.festival.markarth_silv: Markarth's Dwemer terraces shine with silver filigree stalls and floral offerings from the Temple of Dibella.
Golden birch leaves drift over Riften's square as the autumn harvest casks are tapped free for Harvest's End!
skycraft.calendar.festival.tales_and_tal: Candlelit vigils warm Falkreath's twilight as storytellers honour the dead and ward the ancient barrows.
skycraft.calendar.festival.winterhold_ar: Magelight lanterns illuminate Winterhold beneath the autumn aurora as College scholars trade scrolls and charms.
skycraft.calendar.festival.witches_festi: Bonfires crackle in Morthal as apothecaries and monster hunters gather for the Frostfall Witches' Festival.
skycraft.calendar.festival.warriors_fest: Smiths and veterans display honed steel in Windhelm to honour Ysgramor's Five Hundred Companions.
skycraft.calendar.festival.saturalia_old: Warm Saturalia lanterns line Dawnstar's snowy quays as townsfolk exchange gifts and remember the year past.
skycraft.scene.quest.title: Roadside Request: %s
skycraft.scene.wonder.mammoth_herd: A giant herder guides painted mammoths across the open steppe.
skycraft.scene.wonder.pilgrims_at_shrine: Pilgrims kneel in quiet prayer before a wayside shrine.
skycraft.scene.wonder.whiterun_mammoth_d: A giant herder guides painted mammoths across the tundra in the golden dawn light.
skycraft.scene.wonder.aurora_sky_watcher: Scholars and a bard gather by lantern light to watch the northern aurora ripple overhead.
skycraft.scene.wonder.distant_dragon_rid: A dragon surveys the valley from a high rocky ridge while travellers watch from cover.
skycraft.scene.wonder.kynareth_sapling_p: Priests of Kynareth carry sacred sapling offerings along the high road.
skycraft.scene.wonder.sea_of_ghosts_hork: A massive pod of horkers basks on the Sea of Ghosts pack ice as coastal fishers watch the tide.
skycraft.scene.wonder.meridia_beacon_pil: Dawn light catches a hilltop shrine while priests chant against the undead.
skycraft.scene.wonder.bards_college_trou: Travelling Bards College musicians rehearse King Olaf's verse along the road.
skycraft.scene.wonder.falkreath_lantern_: Solemn priests of Arkay and mourners bear lanterns along the pine road.
skycraft.scene.wonder.spriggan_ancient_g: Glowing butterflies and woodland deer gather peacefully around a guardian spriggan.
skycraft.scene.wonder.moonlight_stag_app: A great stag stands in a moonlit glade surrounded by drifting torchbugs.
skycraft.scene.wonder.drajkmyr_wisp_proc: Luminous wisps and torchbugs drift silently across the fog-shrouded fen.
skycraft.scene.wonder.labyrinthian_ghost: Scholars study ancient dragon-cult stones where restless shadows stir in the mist.
skycraft.scene.wonder.morthal_fen_torch_: Boardwalk watchmen light ward-fires through the salt-marsh fog at dusk.
skycraft.scene.wonder.dwemer_great_lift_: An expedition camp studies a venting Dwemer lift while a brass automaton patrols.
skycraft.scene.wonder.vaermina_sleepless: A priest of Mara prays over sleepwalking townsfolk beneath the northern stars.
skycraft.scene.wonder.golden_birch_pilgr: Voice pilgrims and a bard climb the road beneath falling golden birch leaves.
skycraft.scene.wonder.mara_wedding_proce: A joyful betrothed couple and a priest of Mara travel down the road with a bard.
skycraft.scene.wonder.azura_twilight_cha: Dunmer pilgrims chant at twilight toward the mountain shrine of Dusk and Dawn.
skycraft.scene.wonder.college_atronach_f: College of Winterhold mages conduct an outdoor conjuration trial on the ice.
skycraft.scene.wonder.steam_basin_mammot: Mammoths wade in steaming geothermal pools while a giant stands watch on the sulphur rim.
skycraft.scene.wonder.stormcloak_veteran: Veterans march at dusk while a bard sings of Ysgramor and old Skyrim.
skycraft.scene.wonder.karth_gorge_dibell: Priestesses of Dibella cross the misty Karth gorge bearing floral offerings.
skycraft.scene.wonder.sky_haven_cliff_ec: Scholars trace ancient Akaviri carvings below the crags of the Reach.
skycraft.scene.wonder.wispmother_frost_g: A spectral Wispmother and orbiting wisps illuminate a frozen hollow.
skycraft.scene.wonder.morrowind_silt_str: A towering Silt Strider and pack guar rest with Dunmer caravanners near the eastern pass.
skycraft.scene.wonder.valenwood_indrik_g: A luminous Indrik grazes in a misty woodland glade among butterflies.
